reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline or comment proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.
Party roles are correctly identified: Sparkling is the fee-paying licensee (our side) and Garman the licensor, so the direction test ('flag only when Customer pays') is applied correctly.

Cited text supports the preferred position: p0084 obliges Sparkling only to pay scheduled fees with no penalty, default charge or minimum-fee mechanic; p0118 permits termination for convenience on 90 days' notice with no termination fee or buy-out; p0128 operates in our favour (perpetual licence plus refund of prepaid fees on Garman's default).
Rationale correctly distinguishes the mutual limitation-of-liability cap in Section 15 from a stipulated-damages mechanic, and no deterministic check flagged any issue.
